selected_evidence.summary: Installed and verified the cron entry `15 2 * * *` with crond active and enabled before and after reboot.
Direct executions appended successful output; after reboot the existing 56-byte log remained and grew to 112 bytes.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe, acknowledged a scheduled safe reboot, observed new boot ID e9d1dcc2-94b0-428e-a4a7-4b5bd5a8a690, and proved crond, schedule, script, and retained log recovered.

#!/bin/sh
        printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s
' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
        SCRIPT
        chown root:root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
        chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
interpreter=

commands.command:
set -eu
script_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/inventory-maintenance.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$script_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'printf '\''inventory maintenance completed at %s\n'\'' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"' > "$script_tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0755 "$script_tmp" /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
restorecon /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

set -eu
cron_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/inventory-maintenance-cron.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$cron_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'SHELL=/bin/sh' 'PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin' '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' > "$cron_tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$cron_tmp" /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
restorecon /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true
touch /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
chown root:root /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
chmod 0640 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
restorecon /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl reload crond 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart crond

set -eu
printf 'timezone='; timedatectl show -p Timezone --value
printf 'crond_active='; systemctl is-active crond
printf 'crond_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled crond
printf 'script_state='; stat -c '%A %U:%G' /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
printf 'schedule_state='; stat -c '%A %U:%G' /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
printf '%s\n' 'schedule_contents:'; sed -n '1,20p' /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
crond -T
/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
printf '%s\n' 'log_tail:'; tail -n 3 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
printf 'log_state='; stat -c '%A %U:%G size=%s' /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
